create_ObservationPhysics: create an ObservationPhysics instance with a custom observation to pose conversion function
set_observation: set the current observation dictionary on an ObservationPhysics instance for pose lookups
world_pose: get the world pose of a named frame from the current observation
world_pose_position_only: get the world pose of a frame with rotation zeroed out using get_rot false
world_pose_rotation_only: get the world pose of a frame with position zeroed out using get_pos false
